1. List which connectors load at the start of a web session, with their number of tools.
2. Measure the first and second model call's context (input + cache read + cache creation) from the session's own transcript, over several runs.
3. Change one thing at a time where you can (another repository, another environment, network off, the connector off in the account or the environment) and say which decides.

title: Measure what the account's connectors cost on the web, and who decides that they load
verdict: On the web the connectors add ~16,000 tokens at the 2nd call; Vercel 11,798 (3 vs 3 runs). The repo's deniedMcpServers removes it (3/3); disableClaudeAiConnectors does nothing (0/3).
